an7.6:1.3: saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hirīdhanaṃ ottappadhanaṃ sutadhanaṃ cāgadhanaṃ paññādhanaṃ.
an7.6:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an7.6:2.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …pe… buddho bhagavāti
an7.6:3.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
an7.6:4.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako hirīmā hoti hiriyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
an7.6:5.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako ottappī hoti ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
an7.6:6.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an7.6:7.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato
an7.6:8.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti …pe… sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
